verdict.rationale: There is some documented non-interactive operation. Skills can be installed for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi without prompts (gh-2), installs and updates run through explicit `yy skills install`/`update` commands (gh-6), and ledger operations are flag-driven CLI commands (docs-5, docs-6). A `node scripts/validate.mjs` validation script (gh-7) and an isolated-config validation path (docs-2) suit scripted checks. Nothing documents actually running the skills or the Ralph loop headlessly or in a CI pipeline; that depends on the host agent. Missing for 10: documented headless or CI execution mode for the skills/agent loop, CI pipeline examples or integration guidance, independent corroboration.
